plainText:
Lugia and Ho-Oh on the Loose, Part 2 (Japanese: VS ルギア&ホウオウ﻿（後編) VS Lugia & (Part 2)), titled Lugia & Ho-Oh (Part 2) in the Chuang Yi translation, is the 166th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 76th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
 are commanded to use their signature attacks, and . and , on their Tibo and Natee respectively, dodge, but the attacks cause a blast through a part of the stadium's wall and ceiling, throwing Gold and Crystal off their Pokémon. They fall right above the part of the stadium whose roof is about to fall on them, fortunately, Sudobo shields the two s. The audience are still being evacuated.

Gold eventually finds out that the Masked Man was also behind Lugia's rampage at the Whirl Islands, and tricked them into thinking Lugia was still wild at the time. Another blast from the two legendaries' attacks strikes another part of the stadium. Gold and Crystal run, dodging multiple blasts directed at them. Crystal decides that the two should be split apart, thus flies on Natee to face Lugia. Gold occupies Ho-Oh using Sudobo, with Sudobo responding to a Ho-Oh attack using . The Masked Man calls Lugia to assist, but suddenly feels his neck spasm due to Natee's . 

The Masked Man responds by morphing into a more mutated version of himself, and jumps onto Ho-Oh, commanding it to trap Gold and Crystal with a ring of fire. He proceeds to grab both Kurt and his granddaughter Maizie from the evacuating crowd.

==Major events==
and battle against the Masked Man.
The Masked Man goes after Kurt and Maizie.
